name: personal-design-studio
description: Local-first design workbench for CVs, slide decks, reports and dashboards

scripts.build:examples: node bin/studio.mjs build examples/cv.json -o dist/cv.html && node bin/studio.mjs build examples/slides.json -o dist/slides.html && node bin/studio.mjs build examples/report.json -o dist/report.html && node bin/studio.mjs build examples/dashboard.json -o dist/dashboard.html
scripts.check: npm test && node bin/studio.mjs audit examples/cv.json && node bin/studio.mjs audit examples/slides.json && node bin/studio.mjs audit examples/report.json && node bin/studio.mjs audit examples/dashboard.json
